Akshay Singla

(cid:263) akshaysingla0010@gmail.com | (cid:294) +91-9464892690 | (cid:93) linkedin.com/in/akshaysingla90 | (cid:97) github.com/akshaysingla90

Summary 6+ years of experience building and scaling distributed systems and microservice architectures in production, leveraging asynchronous programming, event-driven workflows, and batch processing with Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, MongoDB, Redis, and Kafka. Specialized in Payroll, HRMS, and ERP domains, owning services processing payroll for 200k+ employees and delivering 200× latency improvements and sub-5-minute payroll execution at scale

Skills Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, SQL

Frameworks: Node.js, Express.js, NestJS, React.js, Socket.io, Mocha

Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB

AI Systems: RAG, Vector DBs(pgvector), LLM Workflows, MCP servers

Others: Kafka, Redis, Jenkins, Kubernetes, Docker, Git, AWS(EC2, S3, Lambda, Load Balancer)

Experience Betterplace — HRMS Platform (30M+ Frontline Workers)

Bangalore,India

SDE 3

April 2025 - Present

Designed and optimized distributed database architectures and 40+ NestJS APIs in different feature modules of HRMS payroll product to process over 1.5B+ USD in annual payroll volume for 1,500+enterprises with zero data loss. • Architected and shipped a standalone Doc Generator Service (NestJS, Puppeteer, Kafka, AWS S3) extracted from the payroll monolith to offload payslip and income-tax computation rendering — sustained generation for 10k+ employees concurrently from scratch without degrading the payroll critical path.

Redesigned the payroll job-processing pipeline using BullMQ + Redis implementing batch processing with inde- pendent concurrent workers; cut end-to-end runtime for 200k-employee payrolls from hours to under 5 minutes, eliminating timeout-driven retries.

Integrated AI-assisted development workflows using mcp servers for code investigation, debugging, implementa- tion assistance, and review workflows, reducing feature turnaround time by 30–40% and accelerating issue resolution.

SDE 2

Aug 2023 - March 2025 • Drove P95 latency of the payroll dashboard APIs from 10s to 50ms (~200×) via query aggregation optimisation, redis

caching, and elimination of unnecessary round trips — removed the top customer-reported slowness tickets.

Raised backend test coverage and reliability through Mocha/Chai unit + functional suites wired into CI gates; cut escaped defects in payroll modules by ~38% quarter-over-quarter.

Stack: NestJS, Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, Redis, Apache Kafka, BullMQ, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Mocha, Chai

Recrosoft Technologies — Synamedia (Cloud-Based Streaming Services)

Bangalore,India

Software Engineer

Dec 2020 - Aug 2023

Built BeIN Voice Support, a voice-controlled Set-Top-Box experience integrating an Alexa Video Skill with backend Node.js microservices — delivered sub-300ms end-to-end directive response under production load.

Implemented directive interpretation across all supported Alexa video interfaces (search, play, transport, channel con- trol) — achieved 99.5% intent-completion accuracy on the device fleet.

Owned design and shipped a proxy notification service over an MQTT broker, replacing polling clients; cut message- delivery latency ~75% and lifted publish throughput ~60%.

Profiled and tuned hot paths across the microservices (DB indexes, payload shape, connection reuse) — 30% faster response times and 25% lower server load at the same traffic.

Improved observability across all the directive-processing (structured logs, traces, service-level metrics) — reduced production RCA time across skill interaction/notification incidents.

Mentored 4 junior engineers via code review, pair-programming sessions, and design walkthroughs, two were pro- moted within a year.

Stack: Node.js, TypeScript, Microservices, MongoDB, Redis, MQTT, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins

ChicMic — B2B ERP Platform

Remote,India

Associate Software Engineer

Jan 2019 - Dec 2020

Greenfielded Time Dragon, a B2B ERP unifying project management, employee data, client interactions, and timesheets — owned schema design, REST API layer, and admin dashboard end-to-end.

Architected a real-time chat module on Redis pub/sub + Socket.IO with a horizontally-sharded socket registry — stress-tested to 1M concurrent connections sustaining 2000 msg/sec.

Built Jenkins-based CI/CD pipelines (Bash + Docker) replacing manual deploys across staging and production — cut release lead time ~80% and eliminated hand-rolled SSH steps.

Shipped operational dashboard APIs using MongoDB aggregations to surface real-time user, project, and sales insights for 10k+ employees and 1200+ projects across multiple business units, enabling data-driven decisions for leadership teams.

Stack: Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Socket.IO, Jenkins, Docker

Education Punjabi University, Patiala B.Tech in Computer Science Relevant Coursework: Object Oriented Programming, DSA, DBMS, System Design

2019 CGPA: 8.0/10

Achievements

Betterplace 2025 Excellence Award (top performer) • Recrosoft GEM Award • Code-N-Counter Hackathon(Nagarro)
